protocol.name: scene_001_partial_pairwise_threshold_diagnostic_v1

configuration.selection_policy: No automatic winner or deployment threshold; calibrate on separately designated validation data.
configuration.note: Fixed exploratory grid. Score must be strictly greater than threshold. Threshold 1.0 is the reject-all control.

history_policy.note: Initial diagnostic policy, not tuned or claimed optimal. Include the current observation. Compare latest against the L2-normalized arithmetic mean; preserve all input crop selections.

protocol.counting: Each unordered camera pair once per frame
protocol.objective: maximize sum(similarity - threshold); unmatched gain zero
protocol.labels: Fixed framewise clipped-box IoU >= 0.5; max valid cardinality then max IoU sum
protocol.unknown_labels: Accepted links with either GT label missing are unresolved, not silently correct/incorrect
protocol.verified_correct_fraction_all_links: correct / all accepted, including unresolved in denominator
protocol.recall_available_pairs: correct / shared assigned GT identities in the two current observation sets
protocol.missed_positive_pairs: available positive pairs minus correct accepted links
protocol.no_positive_endpoints: Assigned endpoint GT has no assigned counterpart in the opposite current camera
protocol.components: Connectivity audit only; a missing third link is not proof of different identities
protocol.examples: First five frames with camera-conflict or open-three-camera components per variant/threshold

limits: Exploratory integration sweep; no validation calibration or automatic threshold selection
Counts reuse people across frames/camera pairs; not independent trials
IoU-derived labels are diagnostic and may be ambiguous
Recall is conditional on both people observations being present and GT-assigned
No persistent global IDs or global IDF1; framewise connected components are only audited
No temporal ID-switch recovery, geometry, delayed handover or crop-quality filtering
This run is not a performance benchmark
